caseTriage.heading: Triage
caseTriage.intro: Confirm that this is relevant, set urgency and give it an owner. Or dismiss it with a reason, which is kept with the case.
caseTriage.urgencySuggested: Suggested by the agent that read this change
caseTriage.readOnly: This change needs triage: an urgency and an owner. Someone who can triage changes will pick it up.
caseTriage.dismissBody: It leaves the open list. The reason is kept with the case, and it can be moved back to triage.
caseTriage.dismissReasonRequired: Choose a reason for dismissing it.
caseTriage.nextStepIntro: An impact assessment records whether this applies, what must change and by when.
caseTriage.nextStepReader: The owner starts the impact assessment.
caseTriage.noActionBody: The case closes now, under your name, with the reason you choose. It can be moved back to triage later.
caseTriage.notePlaceholder: For example: our research is paid from client charges already reported
caseTriage.noteHint: The note stays on the case and in its case file.
caseTriage.closeReasonRequired: Choose a reason for closing it.
caseTriage.noReasons: Your organisation's list has no reasons yet. An administrator adds them under Vocabularies.
